respondents.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner made a statement 
at bar that he wants to withdraw his Vakalatnama as the 
petitioner is interested and ready to appear in-person in 
the present writ petition. 
4. The prayer so made is granted. 
5. The Registry is directed not to publish the name of 
Mr. Rajat Mittal, learned counsel for the petitioner in this 
case in cause list henceforth.
6. Petitioner has already moved an application to the 
Registrar General of this Court to permit him to appear in 
the matter in-person. As yet, no permission has been 
granted to him.
7. List this case immediately once the permission is 
granted by the Registrar General.
